visual_review.first_step_observation: The first saved crop contains one confident wide oval opening joined to two sloping sides and one rounded lower edge. Those connected strokes immediately establish the final basket width, front view, ground height, and open upper area where the laundry will overlap.
visual_review.draw_through_observation: I inspected the corrected six-cell sheet and all six saved square JPGs at readable size, then compared every adjacent pair with the written instruction. The basket body, two attached handles, three weave rows, four aligned divider routes, two socks, folded towel, three stripes per sock, stitched edge, two separate highlights, and broken shadow keep stable anchors and overlap order; the final panel only adds the declared marker fills.
